jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor (tenure track)/Associate Professor in Computational end Generative Design
jobs.description:
Are you interested in scientific computing, artificial intelligence, and how they can automate and enhance design of civil engineering structures? Are you interested in creating societal impact with your research? Then the Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering of Aarhus University invites you to apply for this position.

Expected start date and duration of employment
The expected starting date is no later than August 1 2027.

Job description
This position is part of the section for Structural Engineering.
Your tasks will be:

• Teaching/upgrading existing courses related to Structural Engineering at both B.Sc. and M.Sc. level in Civil and Architectural Engineering programmes.
• Supervising students at different levels (e.g., multidisciplinary projects, master theses, doctoral theses).
• Conducting research through externally sponsored grants at national and international levels.
• Establishing relevant collaborations with the Danish industry.
• Contributing to the operation of the department.
Your profile
We are looking for a candidate that can enhance the department’s competencies in computational design. The candidate shall hold:

• Engineering background (B.Sc. and M.Sc.).
• Doctoral degree in a relevant field of research.
• High-level proficiency in English.
The following qualifications and experience are required:

• Scientific computing, possibly with different programming languages (e.g., Python, Julia, C#, C++ MATLAB).
• Parametric and algorithmic building design using, e.g., Rhino/Grasshopper tool suite.
• Physics-informed machine learning, generative and agentic AI for building design automation.
• Teaching and developing computational and generative design courses related to structural engineering.
• Supervision of undergraduate and graduate students (B.Sc., M.Sc., and Ph.D. theses).
Candidates must demonstrate potential for outstanding research and teaching. The selected candidate shall demonstrate:

• Some years of post-graduate research and publication experience are required. A pre-existing and growing international research network is expected. Prior collaboration with the Danish innovation ecosystem is desired, but not essential.
• Experience from successful external research collaborations with industry and academia, project management skills. Experience in the attraction of external funding is preferred.
• Research ability documented through rising publication and citation records evidenced by appropriate bibliometric parameters in reputable international peerreviewed journals.
Well-defined research focus and sound strategy to develop a research group.

Who we are
The Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering at Aarhus University is a growing engineering environment with a clear vision for the future of the built environment.

Established in 2021, the department today includes more than 100 researchers and educators and around 1.050 students. We conduct research and education within structural engineering, geotechnics, architectural engineering and design, sustainability, construction management, climate adaptation, indoor climate, building materials, and digital technologies.

The construction sector is facing major challenges related to climate, resource consumption, and the way we design and build our cities and buildings.

Through research, education, and collaboration with industry and public-sector partners, we contribute to developing technological solutions that support a more sustainable built environment.

Our research and development activities are closely connected to the needs of industry and society, and many projects are carried out in collaboration with companies, public authorities, and other research environments. This ensures that the knowledge and technologies developed at the department are relevant in practice and create value beyond the university.

Education is a central part of the department’s identity. We offer Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD programmes in engineering and continuously work to improve the connection between research, teaching, and practice.

Across our programmes, students work with real-world challenges, current technologies, and sustainable solutions for the construction sector.

What we offer
We offer an innovative and collaborative teaching and research environment with close interaction between students, researchers, and industry partners. The department provides well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories, and access to shared technical facilities. We offer an interdisciplinary environment with national, international, and industrial collaborators. Our academic environment is built on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional dialogue. The workplace is characterised by professionalism, flexibility, and a healthy work–life balance. The department is located at Navitas on the waterfront in Aarhus, Denmark

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is at Navitas, Inge Lehmanns Gade 10, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark. The area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Associate Professor, Giuseppe Abbiati +45 93 52 17 51, abbiati@cae.au.dk.

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than December 14 2026.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment. 

Formalities and salary range 
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.occupation: Process specialist in Nanofabrication to the Niels Bohr Institute
jobs.employer_name: KU- SCIENCE - CHEM og MATH og NBI-HCØ
jobs.description:
The NBI Cleanroom facility at the Niels Bohr Institute seeks an innovative candidate for a time-limited, part-time (8 hours per week) technical position as Process specialist in Nanofabrication.

The NBI Cleanroom is a research infrastructure providing nanofabrication, processing and characterization facilities to the research groups of NBI. With a focus on quantum electronics and quantum photonics, the research and innovation is mainly driven by The Center for Quantum Devices (Q-Dev) www.qdev.dk, Center for Hybrid Quantum Networks (Hy-Q) www.hy-q.nbi.ku.dk, and The Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme (NQCP) https://nqcp.ku.dk, involving coordinated activity in materials growth, processing, characterization, and nanoscale fabrication. The cleanroom also accommodates external commercial user groups.

The position
The candidate will join the department’s existing team of lab technicians and engineers. The tasks within the position are among others to develop processes in close collaboration with researchers and students allowing the fabrication of novel nanostructures for basic and applied research in electronics and other nanodevice applications. This will require the integration of multiple tools and methods, as well as the development of new nanofabrication methods. 

The candidate is expected to contribute within the following areas:

• 
Supervise and train researchers, postdocs and students and other technical staff in using research equipment.

• 
Developing state of the art processes within areas such as Electron Beam Lithography, UV-Lithography, Physical Vapor Deposition, Molecular Beam Epitaxy and Atomic Layer Deposition.

• 
Manage technical collaborations with research teams for the development of the nanofabrication facility.

• 
Maintain and trouble-shoot research equipment in collaboration with technical staff and run regular calibration procedures on the tools.

• 
Share responsibilities for tools and processes and purchases with other members of the technical staff.

Profile
We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic candidate with the following competencies and experience:

• 
Candidates should have a MSc or PhD degree in Electrical engineering or Physics or an equivalent relevant degree.

• 
An in-depth understanding of laboratory safety, and experience with hazardous tools and materials associated with nanofabrication facilities is required.

• 
Thorough knowledge about nanofabrication procedures with emphasis on electron beam lithography preferably using Elionix and Raith tools and skills necessary to design the entire fabrication process.

• 
Experience with device and materials characterization/imaging tools such as scanning probe and scanning/transmission electron microscopy.

• 
Have knowledge about a broad spectrum of nanofabrication methods, semiconductor physics, electronics, physics, mechanical and electrical engineering.

• 
Have cleanroom experience.

Terms of salary and employment
The position is part-time (8 hours per week) and is fixed for a 2-year term. The position is scheduled to start 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.
Employment will be as academic employee or special consultant, and the salary is based on seniority. Employment will be under The Circular on the Collective Agreement concerning Academics in the state sector concluded between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

Application
If you are interested in the position, please submit your electronic application, including attachments, via the UCPH Job Portal (click the “APPLY NOW” link at the bottom of the job posting).

• 
Letter of application addressing the requirements (max. one page).

• 
Current curriculum Vitae

• 
Letters of reference

• 
A certified/signed copy of certificate(s) of education

 Deadline for applications is 4 November 2026

The University wishes to reflect the diversity of the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. 

Further Information 
Questions regarding the position may be directed to Cleanroom Lab Manager Martin Saurbrey Bjergfelt, mail: martin.bjergfelt@nbi.ku.dk, phone +45 23 81 08 93.

jobs.occupation: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
jobs.description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark’s power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installations
You will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

• 
Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

• 
Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

• 
Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

• 
Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibility
You are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Works independently and takes a structured approach

• 
Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

• 
Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

• 
Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

• 
Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call duties
At Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish “fritvalgsordning” scheme.

You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

We look forward to hearing from you
If this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.

If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.

Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.

Can you keep a website fresh, turn ideas into engaging social content, and build workflows that make content production more efficient?

Patiro is looking for a part-time Content and Creative Specialist to manage and develop our content across our website, social media, press releases, and external profiles. You will help us communicate clearly, maintain a consistent brand, and reach the right audiences.

Your responsibilities

You will help us:

• Plan and maintain a content calendar across our channels.

• Write, edit, publish, and update website content, social media posts, press releases, and other communications.

• Keep company listings, directories, and relevant registers accurate and up to date.

• Create visuals and reusable templates in Figma or similar design tools.

• Refine our brand guidelines and apply them consistently across content and design.

• Follow and develop our voice and tone guidelines, adapting communication to different audiences.

• Use artificial intelligence and automation tools, such as Make.com, to improve content workflows, approvals, publishing, and distribution.

• Repurpose content into formats suited to different channels and audiences.

• Improve content discoverability across search engines and artificial intelligence search and answer platforms.

• Track content performance and use the findings to improve topics, formats, and distribution.

• Coordinate with internal experts to ensure content is accurate, relevant, and ready for publication.

What we are looking for

You are someone who:

• Has experience creating and managing content across websites and social media.

• Writes clear, engaging English and can turn complex subjects into accessible stories.

• Has a strong visual eye and practical experience with Figma or similar tools.

• Can share examples of content and creative work you have produced.

• Has hands-on experience using artificial intelligence and automation tools to improve workflows while maintaining editorial quality.

• Understands how content can support awareness, engagement, and action.

• Keeps up with developments in search engine optimisation and content visibility across large language models, generative search, and answer engines.

• Works independently, manages priorities, and takes content from initial idea through publication and review.

• Checks facts carefully and handles sensitive topics with sound judgement.

Technical search optimisation skills are welcome, but are not required. We value strong editorial judgement, creative ability, and the ability to put useful tools into practice.

Additional experience we would value

• Healthcare, clinical research, or patient-facing communications.

• Press releases, media outreach, or corporate communications.

• Content management systems and publishing tools.

• Short-form video creation and editing.

• Community management and audience engagement.

• Content analytics and testing different messages or creative formats.

You will work closely with our leadership, marketing, and medical teams to build a consistent and credible presence for Patiro. We are looking for someone who can contribute ideas and take ownership of the daily work needed to keep our content relevant and our channels active.

careers@patiro.com

Associate Professor of the History and Philosophy of Mathematics (Parttime, Fixed-Term, 3½ years)
 Department of Mathematical Sciences
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  The position is in the history and philosophy of mathematics, with particular emphasis on teaching the history of mathematics within the university’s mathematics programs. The position is primarily associated with teaching, developing, and coordinating courses in the history of mathematics at the undergraduate and graduate levels.

  Applicants must have documented research qualifications within the history of mathematics. Emphasis will be placed on scholarly contributions that combine historical scholarship with a strong understanding of mathematics and its development.

  Applicants are required to have university-level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies, and the ability to explain and reflect on their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training program for assistant professors is required.

  Particular emphasis will be placed on extensive experience teaching the history of mathematics at the university level, including integrating historical perspectives into core mathematics curricula. Experience in developing and coordinating courses in the history of mathematics for students with a mathematical background will be considered an essential qualification.

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management, such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare, and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and outreach qualifications of applicants, including the ability to attract external funding, will also be considered.

  To be qualified for an Associate Professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

  The successful applicant will be part of the Analysis and Quantum Section within the Department of Mathematical Sciences. The department offers an active academic environment and access to its academic networks, facilities, seminars, and teaching community. Further information on the Department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the position can be made to the Head of Department, Mogens Steffensen, at head-of-department@math.ku.dk.

  The position is open from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment
 The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  The position is limited until 31 August 2030.

  The average weekly working hours are approximately 11 hours per week.
 
 When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen

**Vice President, Head of Thickening

****Job Description

****Location

**Global

**Role Purpose

**The Head of Thickening role is accountable for the global business performance and growth of the Thickener product offerings across the entire product lifecycle, encompassing both Capital equipment and Upgrades & Rebuilds (U&R).

This role owns the global P&L, commercial strategy, market positioning, pricing strategy, and product roadmap. Responsible for driving aggressive volume growth while protecting and growing profitability targets by maximizing customer value and ensuring a seamless customer offering throughout the lifecycle of installed equipment.

Working across a complex matrix organization, the VP leads the commercialization of both new equipment, upgrades and rebuilds, partnering closely with Capital Sales, Regional Sales, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations and Services, to accelerate growth and create sustainable competitive advantage.

**Executive Profile

**The successful candidate must combine strong commercial leadership with a recognized understanding of thickening technologies and their application in minerals processing.

While supported by a team of product managers, application engineers, and technical experts, the Head of Thickening must possess sufficient technical depth and industry credibility to engage confidently with customers, challenge assumptions, evaluate product strategies, and make informed business decisions. The role requires an executive capable of driving business growth while serving as a trusted authority on the Thickener portfolio across both Capital equipment and lifecycle solutions.

**Key Responsibilities

****Business and P&L Leadership

**

• Own the global P&L for the Thickeners portfolio, including Revenue, Operating Income, Contribution Margin, market share, and profitability.

• Develop and execute the long-term business strategy and growth plan for both Capital and Upgrades & Rebuilds businesses.

• Monitor market dynamics, customer trends, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities and business risks.

**Upgrades & Rebuilds Growth

**

• Own the global strategy, growth, and profitability of the Upgrades & Rebuilds business within the Thickeners portfolio.

• Develop lifecycle offerings that increase customer productivity, sustainability, and equipment performance.

• Collaborate with regional commercial teams to identify modernization, expansion, and rebuild opportunities across the installed base.

• Establish standardized upgrade packages, retrofit solutions, and value propositions that are scalable globally.

• Drive alignment between global product strategy and regional commercial execution.

**Product and Portfolio Strategy

**

• Define the global product roadmap and lifecycle strategy for the Thickeners portfolio.

• Collaborate with Engineering to prioritize innovation investments and technology development.

• Lead market assessments to identify customer needs, emerging trends, and competitive opportunities.

• Ensure product offerings remain differentiated, profitable, and aligned with market requirements.

• Drive standardization, product optimization, digital offerings, and sustainable technology initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Leadership

**

• Lead and influence a highly matrixed global organization without relying solely on direct authority.

• Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Services, Finance, and Regional leadership teams to execute business objectives.

• Ensure alignment between commercial commitments, operational capabilities, and customer expectations.

• Support execution excellence throughout the order lifecycle to maximize customer satisfaction and long-term portfolio success.

**Candidate Profile

**The ideal candidate is a commercially driven business leader with deep experience in thickening technology and minerals processing. They have successfully managed a significant product line, business unit, or portfolio with responsibility for growth, profitability, and market strategy. They are equally comfortable discussing thickener performance and applications with customers and engineers as they are leading commercial negotiations, reviewing business performance, and driving strategic growth initiatives.

**Experience

• Significant experience with thickening technologies, dewatering solutions, or adjacent process equipment used in mineral processing operations.

• Demonstrated understanding of thickener applications, customer processes, operational challenges, product performance drivers, and aftermarket opportunities throughout the equipment lifecycle.

• Proven success leading a global business, product line, service line, or business unit with accountability for revenue growth and profitability.

• Strong commercial leadership experience, including business development, sales strategy, pricing, market expansion, and P&L ownership.

• Track record of driving growth across both capital equipment sales and aftermarket offerings such as upgrades, rebuilds, modernization programs, and lifecycle services.

• Experience working across highly matrixed global organizations and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Established credibility engaging with customers, engineering teams, technical specialists, and regional commercial organizations at a strategic level.

**Education

**

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent preferred.

**Core Competencies

**

• Commercial Leadership

• P&L Management

• Strategic Thinking

• Stakeholder Management

• People Leadership

• Thickening Technology Expertise

• Sales & Business Development

jobs.occupation: Analog IC Design Lead
jobs.description:
Jeppe Birch Højrup

Analog IC Design Lead – Power Management

Lotus Microsystems is looking for a motivated and experienced Analog IC Design Lead – Power Management to join our team at our headquarters in Copenhagen. Join a DeepTech company at the forefront of innovation, where ideas move quickly from concept to reality in a collaborative startup environment.

Position Summary

We are looking for an experienced Analog IC Design Lead – Power Management to join our Engineering team. You will lead and contribute to the development of next-generation power converters for a wide range of applications.

You will work on state-of-the-art power management technology alongside a team with hands-on expertise in power electronics, IC design, and semiconductor process development. The role combines technical leadership with hands-on circuit design and close collaboration across disciplines.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership for IC development projects and design activities.

• Design integrated power converters and monitoring circuits.

• Design analog and mixed-signal circuit blocks.

• Drive and coordinate IC design and layout activities, working closely with design and layout engineers.

• Simulate and verify circuits using transistor-level and system-level simulation tools.

• Contribute to silicon validation, characterization, and troubleshooting.

• Collaborate with engineers across IC design, power electronics, semiconductor processes, and system development.

Qualifications

• Master’s degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

• At least 10 years of relevant IC design experience.

• Strong understanding of and hands-on experience with power converters, such as linear regulators, switched-inductor DC-DC converters, and switched-capacitor DC-DC converters.

• In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in designing integrated power converters, gate drivers, and PWM control circuits.

• In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in designing analog circuits, including comparators, amplifiers, current sensors, temperature sensors, bandgap references, and related building blocks.

• Experience with IC design environments and EDA tools, such as Cadence (preferred), Synopsys, and/or Mentor Graphics.

• Experience with technical leadership, project leadership, and/or technology leadership in previous IC development projects is a plus.

• Experience with power management ICs (PMICs) and DC-DC converter applications is a plus.

• Experience with PCB design, assembly, and experimental/silicon validation is a plus.

Personal Competencies

• Based in Copenhagen or within reasonable commuting distance. Lotus Microsystems will support relocation for the right candidate, where needed.

• Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international team.

• A creative, curious, and innovative mindset, with a passion for solving complex technical challenges.

• Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain and champion new ideas, actively contribute to brainstorming, and present technical concepts clearly.

• Strong planning and time-management skills, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment.

Additional Information

For more information about the position, please contact Martin Lantz, IC Design Manager, at mlantz@lotus-microsystems.com.

We will process candidates on a running basis.

About Us

Lotus Microsystems creates advanced power solutions that transform power and thermal management, unlocking the full potential of AI and advanced computing. Our patented power silicon interposer technology enables miniaturized power delivery systems with exceptional power density and thermal performance.

At Lotus Microsystems in Copenhagen, you will experience an informal, collaborative, and hands-on work environment. Our open office setup fosters strong teamwork and close interaction among colleagues.

Although we are a small team, we are truly international, with colleagues from diverse professional and cultural backgrounds. This diversity enriches our work and gives us a global perspective that resonates with our international customers and partners.

Join Lotus Microsystems and help us develop cutting-edge power technology that can make a meaningful impact on the future of AI and advanced computing.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 20,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

jobs.occupation: Principal Design System Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Principal Design System Engineer to help shape and drive the continued evolution of Lighthouse Design System, 3Shape’s design system across web, mobile, and on-premises software solutions.

You will be the first dedicated Design System engineer and will be overall responsible for defining the technical direction and development of Lighthouse Design System. In this role, you will combine technical leadership, hands-on engineering, and cross-functional collaboration. Together with other colleagues, you will build a scalable foundation that enables our product teams to efficiently deliver consistent, accessible, and high-quality experiences. To achieve this, you will be balancing technical solutions with stakeholder management – staying ambitious yet pragmatic with the product. Likewise, you will be fundamental in creating followership across the broader organization, in ensuring its implementation, adaptability and recognition.

Becoming our new colleague means becoming a 3Shaper. Here we work to improve treatment and diagnostics for dental patients. We do this by providing innovative 3D scanners and advanced software for dental professionals that improve dental care and patients’ lives worldwide.

Key responsibilities

• 
Champion continuous improvement in how we develop, drive and implement the Lighthouse Design System, ensuring high ambition yet pragmatic approach to the result.

• 
Creating followership, by enabling product teams to adopt, contribute to, and get value from the Lighthouse Design System.

• 
Raise the engineering bar across front-end teams, by establishing scalable engineering standards, patterns, and quality practices across web, mobile, and on-premise software solutions.

• 
Own and mature our internal component library - balancing scalability, usability, performance, and maintainability.

• 
Partner with Product Portfolio Strategy and the Design System UX Lead, to ensure technical robustness, business impact and end-user value.

• 
Mentor and coach engineers that contribute to the Lighthouse Design System along with staying hands-on during key technical initiatives.

What are we looking for?

• 
10+ years software engineering experience, with significant experience in design system management and front-end development having held a similar principal or staff-level engineering role.

• 
Proven ability to influence technical adoption and direction for Design System adoption in an organization with many technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• 
Strong experience with Angular / TypeScript and modern front-end engineering. If you have experience working with multiple architectural design patterns across multiple tech-stacks, it is considered a plus.

• 
Strong experience with building and maintaining component libraries, design systems, or platform-like products serving multiple teams and the ability to establish clear approaches for ownership boundaries, versioning, and backwards compatibility.

• 
Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to a strong engineering culture.

• 
Experience of working closely together with designers and product managers and navigating technical trade-offs across multiple stakeholders.

• 
Experience in applying AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and developer experience, while maintaining strong technical standards and human oversight.

• 
Experience with improving developer experience through tooling, automation, documentation, or processes. To improve the way teams, contribute to and adopt the design system.

• 
A pragmatic and hands-on approach, with a passion for building simple and scalable solutions to complex problems.

We offer

• 
A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and cooperative colleagues - we are more than 40 nationalities in our DK based office.

• 
An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• 
Breakfast every day, and a delicious, healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
We provide a great social work environment with many voluntary activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games and running to bicycle clubs.

• 
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

• 
A clear, shared purpose: Help improve dental patient care on a global scale.

Get in touch now!

Please do not hesitate to apply for this exciting opportunity at one of Denmark’s most successful and fastest growing high-tech companies, as applications will be processed continuously.

You don’t need to meet every criteria to be successful in this role. If you bring strong experience working with design systems, are excited by the opportunity to shape a design system on a large scale and can see yourself growing in the other areas then we do encourage you to apply.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.
